data.name: Idris
data.gender_notes: Idris is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root د-ر-س (d-r-s), 'to study'. Idrīs means 'studious, interpreter'. Its root is د-ر-س (d-r-s). The prophet Idrīs, mentioned in the Qur'an (19:56). Idris is a Arabic name meaning “Interpreter; studious; (also) a prophet”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Idris expresses “Interpreter; studious; (also) a prophet”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root د-ر-س (d-r-s), 'to study'. Idrīs means 'studious, interpreter'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Idris total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
